text.tspan: Attach to a Terminal over WebSocket
What <sidecar-terminal> and the SDK do on one terminal WebSocket in U0: handshake, resolve and open a target, approximate focus-wins on the v0 control operations, type, and leave cleanly.
Each WebSocket text message is one protocol envelope.
Connect target with fitted columns and rows
The server resolves the selector again and refuses a changed identity rather than falling back.
Carried through the bridge like every envelope.
U0 approximates focus-wins in the SDK: claim on display while focused, claim on input, release on blur. U1 moves this rule into the server as presence.
control granted; frames at this size
v1 replaces this with reset-free frames from the screen
The bridge also pings every 30 seconds and drops a peer
Leaving never affects the tmux session or other viewers.
Close is end-of-stream: the server releases this stream's
lease exactly as on stdin EOF.
